required_checks.proves: Kotlin Multiplatform source sets and shared Compose application structure exist
commonMain has no Android or UIKit implementation dependencies
shared async work uses structured coroutines, StateFlow, and bounded effects
Android application and adapter compile and pass tests
iOS application and adapter compile and pass simulator tests
both platform engines implement one capability-aware shared meeting contract
room and meeting workflows preserve supported Android behavior and honest iOS fallbacks
clean dependency resolution does not require unavailable legacy artifacts
credential-bearing local files are untracked, ignored, and absent from generated evidence
only the fork's kmp-fast-vm-test branch was mutated
architecture, capability, build, test, and migration documentation is complete
